definitions.explanation: While something is happening; at the peak of an activity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧
examples.english: In the middle of a meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さいちゅう}
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A phone call came in the middle of work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きて→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An earthquake occurred during the exam, and everyone evacuated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧{最中|さいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{急|きゅう}に→急に：00263_kyuuni⟧⟦バッテリー→バッテリー：04425_batterii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れて→切れる：01936_kireru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: While I was talking on the phone with a friend, the battery suddenly died.

notes:
{最中|さいちゅう} means "in the very middle of" an activity or event. It emphasizes that the action is actively in progress at that moment.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Noun + の{最中|さいちゅう}に: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最中|さいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (in the middle of a meeting)
- Verb ている + {最中|さいちゅう}に: ⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧{最中|さいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (while talking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最中|さいちゅう}: right in the middle of (emphasizes the peak of activity)
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧: midway through, on the way (emphasizes being partway through)
- ⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: during (more general time frame)

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{最中|もなか}→最中：noentry⟧, a completely different word meaning a traditional Japanese wafer sweet filled with bean paste.

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. In casual speech, ～している⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧に is more natural.
